The site is pretty good. Launching a product is smooth. But there are so many issues with the UI of the site:  The Launch tips popup is too high to fit the laptop screen  The page is too wide on the large monitor and gets a horizontal scroll bar  The mobile version shows data about the products not visible on desktop (like "product platform")  In the mobile version there is no way of reaching a product discussion, even as an admin of the product (!)  etc, etc. Being a page of this size, having a UX this weak is not great. With so many UX/UI people in the community it should have been easy to test and fix things like this.
